scope: Chinese GitHub README first edition with five user-provided device photos, seven existing host-rendered UI images, quick start and engineering guide. Full-feature video explicitly deferred by the user.

validation.assets: Twelve unique local README image paths; all originals and publication hashes checked. Seven PNGs byte-identical; five JPEG encoded image scan byte streams identical after removing metadata.
validation.browser: GitHub Markdown API output rendered in a localhost preview with approximate GitHub-style CSS; 1280px desktop and 390px phone viewport visually inspected. All12 images decoded, no document horizontal overflow; gallery anchor clicked. Actual GitHub page readback follows PR publication.
validation.review: Primary source/image review plus independent read-only review requested gpt-6.1-sol/medium; no definite blocker. Effective model is not exposed in the tool result.
validation.hardware_operation: none; user supplied photos, no serial enumeration, reset, flash or new device acceptance

failures_preserved: System Python lacked Pillow for metadata inspection. Used standard-library JPEG marker checks instead; no package installation.
An initial JPEG preflight detected EXIF and stopped before publication; publication copies remove metadata while retaining original encoded scan bytes.
Initial preview tab expired across user input; recreated only the task preview, leaving reference tabs unchanged.
limits: Five original-resolution device photos dominate the23,948,151B media payload; no thumbnail resizing or pixel edits in this edition.
Exact capture source commits were not recorded for historical UI images; current board BIN was not independently queried for new user photos.
Root project code license remains unspecified; no license chosen or new image sublicense added.
No new current/DEEP/battery-life, magnetic-north, calibration, health algorithm, BLE security or all-feature hardware claim.
Video is deferred to a later full-feature recording by explicit user instruction.
